:::{#exr-affine-map-zero-practice}
#### Recovering a column of an affine map's matrix from two values

@thm-affine-map-zero says that the value of an [affine map](#def-affine-map) at $\vzero$ is its [offset](#def-affine-offset),
so subtracting that value isolates the [matrix](#def-matrix) part.
Let $f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx + \vec{b}$ be an affine map from $\reals^2$ to $\reals^2$ with

$$
f(\vzero) = \sbmat{1 \\ 2},
\qquad
f\paren{\sbmat{1 \\ 0}} = \sbmat{4 \\ 2}.
$$

Find the first [column of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-column).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

$\matr{A} \sbmat{1 \\ 0}$ is the first [column of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-column).

:::

:::
